annotations.title: Screenshot a lock screen with notifications

description:
Render a single frame of an iOS lock screen with notifications to a PNG and return it as an image. Defaults to the last frame — pass "frame" to capture an earlier moment (30 fps).

Returns the PNG as image content, plus a text line with the PNG's URL (expires after 24 hours).

If the input is invalid, this returns an error result with the validation messages instead of an image.

Lock screen format (an iOS 26 lock screen with notifications):

The video starts on a lock screen (wallpaper, big clock, date, padlock, flashlight and camera buttons). Each notification is a Liquid Glass card from one app (imessage, whatsapp, instagram, chatgpt, claude, reddit, mail, phone, facetime, notes, reminders) with a bold title (usually the sender), a body of up to 4 lines, and a grey time such as "now" or "2m ago". A card lands at its "at" second (seconds from the start of the video) and springs in from the bottom; at 0 it is already there. At least one notification is required. The video ends "endHold" seconds (default 2) after the last card has settled.

Wallpaper and avatars are https image URLs or data: URIs (local file paths are not available). Without a wallpaper a dark gradient is drawn. "avatar" on a notification shows the contact's photo with the app icon as a small badge. "display": "stack" folds the cards like iOS does (newest on top with slivers behind); "list" shows every card.

camera.description: Camera button bottom right. Default: true.

carrier.description: Network name on the left of the status bar. Default: none.

clockOpacity.description: Clock opacity, 0-1; below 1 the wallpaper shows faintly through it. Default: 0.88.

clockSize.description: Clock size in points on a 402 pt wide iPhone screen. Default: 100.

clockStretch.description: Vertical stretch of the clock numerals. Default: 1.18.

date.description: The line above the clock, e.g. "Tuesday, October 6". Default: "Tuesday, October 6".

dim.description: Black overlay on the wallpaper, 0 to 1. Default: 0.

display.description: "list" shows every card; "stack" shows the newest with one or two slivers behind it. Default: list.

endHold.description: Seconds to hold on the last frame after the last card has settled. Default: 2.

flashlight.description: Flashlight button bottom left. Default: true.

frame.description: Frame index to capture, at 30 fps (e.g. 30 = one second in). Omit to capture the final frame, with every notification on screen.

notifications.description:
The notifications, 1 to 20, in any order (they are shown oldest first by "at"; ties keep the written order).

The video ends "endHold" seconds (default 2) after the last card has settled.

"avatar" on a notification shows the contact's photo with the app icon as a small badge. app.description: Which app sent it, so the card wears its icon: "imessage", "whatsapp", "instagram", "chatgpt", "claude", "reddit", "mail", "phone", "facetime", "notes", "reminders". Default: imessage.

at.description: Seconds into the video when this card lands. 0 = already on screen at the first frame. Default: 0.

avatar.description: The contact's photo as an image URL or a data: URI; the app icon shrinks to a badge on it. Omitted: the app icon is drawn.

body.description: The message text. Up to 4 lines are shown, then an ellipsis.

title.description: Bold first line: the contact's name (emoji stay in colour) or the app's headline.

when.description: Grey text on the right, e.g. "now", "2m ago", "9:41 AM". Default: "now".

padlock.description: Small locked padlock above the date. Default: true.

sounds.description: The iOS notification tone when each card lands (video only). Default: true.

statusBar.description: Right side of the status bar. (The clock there is not shown on a lock screen.)

recording.description: Red pill behind the status bar clock, as in an iPhone screen recording. Default: false.

wifi.description: Show the wifi icon. Default: true.

theme.description: Glass tint: "light" = pale glass with dark text, "dark" = smoked glass with white text. Default: light.

time.description: The big clock, without AM/PM, e.g. "9:41". Default: "9:41".

wallpaper.description: Full-bleed wallpaper image: URL or data: URI. Omitted: a dark gradient.

wallpaperX.description: Where the crop is centred horizontally when the image is not 9:16, in % (50 = middle). Default: 50.

wallpaperY.description: Where the crop is centred vertically, in % (50 = middle). Default: 50.

wallpaperZoom.description: 1 = cover the screen, 2 = twice as close. Default: 1.
